projects.name: PULSE CRM
projects.desc: A static CRM for electrical-distribution demos: multi-line quotes, shelf stock, orders, and job-site deliveries. The sample book is inspired by counter sales at Marshall E. Campbell. It is a prototype, not an official product.

projects.name: MemeCoiner
projects.desc: Memewatch: a rules-based scanner for new and gaining memecoins. The dashboard scores liquidity, volume, and momentum from public APIs, and a GitHub Action can ping Discord. A screener, not a prediction.

projects.name: much-wow-memecoins
projects.desc: MUCH WOW is a meme-coin field guide: a live board, heatmap, sector lore, a rug-pull guide, and a parody coin forge.

projects.name: B & J Spray Foam
projects.desc: Marketing site for B & J Spray Foam — open- and closed-cell insulation and air sealing for homes, pole barns, and commercial buildings in mid-Michigan.

notes.title: About me
notes.body:
Hey, I'm Ryan. I'm a developer in Southfield, Michigan.

I learn by building. Lately that means a CRM demo for electrical distribution, meme-coin screens, and client sites — plus the data work I do with Power BI.

I'm PL-300 certified and I work at Marshall E. Campbell. The dashboards and the side projects scratch the same itch: make the numbers and the workflow easier to see.

When I'm not coding, I'm usually in Minecraft or Forza Horizon.

notes.title: What I'm building
notes.body:
• PULSE — quotes, inventory, orders, and deliveries for distributor demos
• MemeCoiner — rules-based memecoin alerts
• MUCH WOW — a live meme-coin field guide
• B & J Spray Foam — a mid-Michigan insulation site

notes.title: Stack
notes.body:
Languages: JavaScript, HTML, CSS
Data: Power BI, PL-300, spreadsheets
Front end: static sites on GitHub Pages
Other: public market APIs, localStorage apps, Discord webhooks
